# Vrundavan Ventures — AI Agent Specification & Context (llms.txt)
> Verified Rental Marketplace for PGs, Private Rooms, Flats & Family Houses across India.

## About Vrundavan Ventures
Vrundavan Ventures (https://vrundavanventures.com) connects tenants (students, working professionals, families) directly with verified property hosts and landlords across India with 100% transparent pricing and direct WhatsApp/Phone communication.

## Rental Categories
1. **PGs & Coliving**: Luxury paying guest accommodations with food, WiFi, housekeeping, and biometric security.
2. **Private Rental Rooms (1RK)**: Independent furnished single rooms and studio apartments for budget-friendly living.
3. **Rental Houses & Flats (1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK)**: Residential apartments and standalone houses for families and corporate executives.

## Agentic API Endpoints for AI Assistants
- `GET /api/pgs`: Query verified listings with parameters:
  - `city` (string, e.g. "Rajkot", "Bengaluru", "Pune", "Mumbai", "Hyderabad", "Gurugram")
  - `propertyType` ("all" | "pg" | "room" | "house" | "flat")
  - `suitableFor` ("all" | "Family" | "Working Professionals" | "Students")
  - `minRent` / `maxRent` (number, INR)
  - `lat` / `lng` / `radius` (GPS proximity radius in km)
- `GET /api/pgs/{id}`: Detailed property object with room sharing options, deposits, house rules, amenities, and owner contact.
- `POST /api/ai/match`: Provide tenant budget, city, preferences for automated top 3 recommendations.
- `POST /api/ai/chat`: Natural language real estate concierge assistant.
